div.div:
The rule, as code
build.gradle collects violations at configuration time into plain serializable data, so the task body never touches Project and the configuration cache can store the result. Two kinds of edge fail it: a ProjectDependency whose path starts with :services:agent, and any dependency whose group starts with one of the four prefixes on the right.
The task prints how many modules it inspected, so a vacuous pass is never mistaken for a verified one.
